name: ai.ludo/game-assets
title: Ludo AI Game Assets
description: Generate game assets with AI: sprites, animations, 3D models with rigging, video, music, SFX, voices

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: API key from Ludo AI (format: 'ApiKey your-api-key'). Get your key at https://app.ludo.ai

examples.name: Generate a Pixel Art Sprite
examples.description: Character sprite in a chosen style

examples.name: Animate a Sprite
examples.description: Walk cycle spritesheet from a static sprite
examples.note: animateSprite with initial_image='url', motion_prompt='walking cycle'; hydra (default) also returns a sound effect

examples.name: Sprite to Animated 3D Model
examples.description: GLB model, rigged, then animated from text
examples.note: create3DModel, then rigModel, then animate3DModel with prompt='walking'

examples.name: 3D Model to Directional Sprites
examples.description: Styled sprites from up to 8 directions that line up
examples.note: create3DModel with rig=true, previewDirectionalSprites (free), then createDirectionalSprites with preset_id='walk_relaxed', directions=['S','SW','W']

examples.name: Generate a Sound Effect
examples.note: createSoundEffect with description='futuristic laser gun firing'

examples.name: Collect a Result
examples.description: Generation tools return a job id
examples.note: getApiJob with id and wait=30 until status is 'succeeded', then read result

examples.name: Look Up a Feature
examples.note: searchDocs with query='how do I pick a sprite animation mode' (free)

examples.name: Report a Limitation
examples.description: Tell the Ludo team what did not work
examples.note: submitApiFeedback with category='limitation' and a message (free)

notes: Credit-based: images 0.5, 3D models 4 (hero 15), rigging 1, 3D animation 0.2, directional sprites 1 per direction, sprite animation and video priced per second by model, audio 1-3. Each tool states its price
Every generation tool is asynchronous: it returns {id, status:'queued'}; collect the result with getApiJob (wait up to 60s to long-poll)
Up to 50 generations queued or running per account; read endpoints 150 requests per 5 minutes per API key
Generated asset URLs expire after 7 days: download anything you want to keep
